gwt.given: A ShardsValues instance was constructed via ShardsValues(IList<short> list) with an empty list, so its Shards property is null.
gwt.when: The caller calls CopyTo(new ShardParameterValue[0], 0) on that instance.
gwt.then: The call throws a System.NullReferenceException before any enumeration of the collection's elements occurs: CopyTo first evaluates this.Count to size its temporary result array, and the Count getter's foreach (var shd in Shards) dereferences the null Shards dictionary immediately — CopyTo never reaches its own foreach over ((IEnumerable<ShardParameterValue>)this), so the enumerator for that sequence is never created and its MoveNext is never called.
